activity.notes: Abd al-Rahman III proclaimed himself caliph in 929, founding the Caliphate of Cordoba, and remained caliph until his death in 961. ATLAS records this separately from his preceding 912-929 emirate because both the polity form and sovereign title changed in 929.

sources.title: Historical overview 2024 — National Atlas of Spain
sources.citation_text: The National Atlas of Spain dates the Caliphate of Cordoba to 929-1031 and identifies Abd al-Rahman III as the eighth emir who was proclaimed caliph in 929.

sources.title: The history — Mosque-Cathedral of Cordoba
sources.citation_text: The official Mosque-Cathedral history gives Abd al-Rahman III's caliphal period as 929-961 and states that his proclamation instituted the Caliphate of Cordoba.
